deviations: Contract: `wrap` skips the second `depositor.require_auth()` when the depositor is already one of the provided signers (spec §4.7 says the wrap body is unchanged). Reason: the host (recording mode, which RPC preflight also uses) rejects a second require_auth for the same address within one frame (`Error(Auth, ExistingValue)` "frame is already authorized" — soroban-env-host auth.rs record_invocation), so the spec's fixture (`seed` = real `wrap(quorum containing the holder, holder)`) is impossible against the unchanged body, and the old contract could never wrap for a signer-depositor on-chain either (the old test suite bypassed it with direct storage seeding; testnet test_wrap_tokens exercised exactly this and had never passed). verify_multisig already require_auth's every provided signer, so the depositor still authorizes the invocation; a non-signer depositor is unchanged.

test_event_abi_pins compares `(contract, topics, data.get_payload())` instead of the tuple `(Address, Vec<Val>, Val)` — `Val` has no PartialEq in soroban-env-common 23.0.1 so the spec's assert_eq! does not compile; the raw payload pins the data's type tag and value for the small immediates emitted. Events are also captured before any read call because the host resets the event buffer on every top-level invocation.
